about_the_game:
Virago World is a cozy yet thrilling farming and life simulation game with a unique psychological twist. By day, plant and grow beautiful flowers, work shifts at Tall Lady Victoria’s flower shop, and design your dream home using the blossoms you nurture. Befriend townspeople by gifting them your prized flowers, and raise loyal pets a protective dog and a cuddly cat to keep you company.

But as night falls, Virago World transforms. Stalkers lurk in the darkness, forcing you to evade danger and survive until morning. Balance your peaceful farming life with the challenge of escaping the shadows that follow you after dusk.

Features:
• Grow and harvest a wide variety of flowers
• Decorate and customize your house with your own floral designs
• Adopt a dog for protection and a cat for companionship
• Build relationships with townspeople through meaningful gifts
• Survive the night by avoiding stalkers who emerge in the dark
• Work at Victoria’s flower shop to sell your creations and develop your skills

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel CPUs - Dual Core 2.2 GHz to Quad Core 3.2GHz; AMD CPUS - Dual Core 2.4Ghz to Quad Core 3.2Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT 512MB to NVIDIA GeForce GTX 580 1536MB or Radeon HD3000 512MB to Radeon HD 6850 1024MB
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
